interpretation: Raw agreement with frozen sparse synthetic target labels; not semantic precision or real-PR quality

configuration.modelIdentity: Gateway-reported name; underlying vendor/model identity not independently attested

scorer.primaryMatch: one-to-one same-path match where the predicted inclusive range covers truth.start_line
scorer.secondaryMatch: one-to-one same-path match where truth.start_line is within 2 lines of the predicted range
scorer.incompletePolicy: No true positives or clean hits; every expected finding is false-negative and every returned prediction is false-positive
scorer.semanticIdentity: unavailable: current PR-Agent finding schema has no CWE/rule_id; path/line matches are not CWE semantic accuracy
scorer.selectionPolicy: all 100 frozen cases in original index order; no resampling, cherry-picking, or failed-case deletion

publicPriceEstimate.assumption: Treat all reported input as uncached; exclude unreported cache-write fees and prior connectivity/diagnostic/smoke requests

annotationAudit.assumption: after_files are complete modules, consistent with runner coverage; externally injected globals are not encoded

semanticAudit.method: Independent agent read review, not human-labelled rescoring

limitations: This is a single-pass synthetic controlled benchmark, not an independently human-labelled real-PR quality evaluation.
The dataset has 100 cases and 10 repositories, below the formal 300-case/30-repository release threshold.
There is no development/train split and expected findings omit should_comment; this scorer treats every listed expected finding as comment-worthy.
Path/line matching cannot prove the predicted issue has the expected CWE or rule identity.
The EvoAgent dataset declares synthetic-controlled provenance and is not an independent real PR quality dataset.
Expected findings are held out from model prompts and used only as offline scoring inputs.
The runner shares production roles, critic, schemas, read tools and evidence gate, but uses an in-memory port instead of the durable PostgreSQL worker.
A single pass without retries or repeated sampling cannot establish production quality or release qualification.
Provider-reported cost has no trusted currency metadata in this configuration and is not treated as verified spend.
Sparse and defective expected-clean annotations penalize valid extra findings; raw false-positive counts are not audited model errors.
Location matches can refer to a different defect on the same line.
Tool evidence envelopes were not persisted; not all evidence-location rejection predicates can be reconstructed.
Actual gateway input usage exceeds local token estimates; this run does not validate durable admission accounting.
